llm_response.reason: The website closely mimics the official Pokémon Center store layout and products but uses a newly registered and privacy-shielded domain ('pokemoncenterca.com'), while the official Pokémon Center site for North America is 'pokemoncenter.com'. The site attempts to impersonate the legitimate brand and hides ownership details, which are common characteristics of scam sites. There is no official connection to The Pokémon Company, and the registration details show no transparency or legitimacy. These factors indicate this is a fake online shopping scam.
